client_rpc_wait.control: Flag `--timeout-ms`, floored at 1 ms; values above this default are permitted.
client_rpc_wait.counting: One absolute client allowance, including helper launch/stdin delivery, reservation acquisition and the execution reply wait. Direct helper invocation starts after reading input.
client_rpc_wait.effect: Overall expiry reports xpc_timeout with the captured submission state. Acquisition may stop earlier at its attempt bound. Expiry after invocation does not establish nonexecution or cancel host work; worker/validator budgets remain separate.

reservation_attempts.counting: Every opened acquisition attempt, including transport failures and occupied replies.
reservation_attempts.effect: Exhaustion ends acquisition explicitly at attempt_limit with no submission; it can precede the overall timeout. Every attempted acquisition stays in the capture.

reservation_lease.counting: Requested unused lease, capped by the host; the client requests no more than its remaining allowance.
reservation_lease.effect: Expiry or owner disconnect retires the unused host. Submission checks expiry atomically and an old timer cannot terminate execution.

reservation_retry_delay.counting: Minimum delay between a failed/occupied attempt and another connection, within the remaining allowance.
reservation_retry_delay.effect: No delay after a successful grant. Scheduling may take longer; neither waiting nor progress renews the deadline.

reservation_rpc_wait.counting: Maximum wait for one reserve reply, also bounded by the original overall client deadline.
reservation_rpc_wait.effect: Expiry abandons and invalidates that connection; acquisition may continue without submitting a specimen.
